shared: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a single production ICON ATLAS for shared magic in Pantheon Realms. References are STYLE ONLY: match existing painted gold and enamel inventory icons, deep dark outlines, sculptural realistic textures and rich tiny highlights. Classic illustrated fantasy strategy game. No flat vectors, circles-as-placeholder-sigils or modern UI. Transparent background. EXACT rectangular grid 4 columns by 2 rows, equal square cells, row-major reading order. EACH icon must fit completely INSIDE its cell with 12% empty transparent margins. No borders, no captions, no letters. Eight equal square cells; the last TWO cells are completely EMPTY transparent, the first six hold icons. Absolutely no backdrop or full-cell glow. Transparent isolated objects, just like the references. Icon subjects in reading order: 1. Arcane Needle: slender violet crystal needle wrapped in gold filigree; 2. Searing Cinder: glowing coal cracking open with small orange flame; 3. Crystal Lance: faceted amethyst spear with sharp quartz shards; 4. Gravity Bloom: bent silver orb collapsing inward with floating dark stone fragments; 5. Astral Execution: celestial silver blade descending from a star with violet dust; 6. Comet Convergence: three distinct white gold comets colliding into a starburst. Rich material differences, distinct silhouettes. The last two are also spells.
